name: Shioyama Suzune
source:
A patissiere girl who works at the cafe. Older sister of Hiroto.

She has a friendly, candid personality, but can also be rather lazy. She never helps out with chores at her parents' house nor her apartment where she lives by herself, which has caused it to become quite messy. But she takes her work at the cafe very seriously, and you'll never find her slacking off.

She's very particular about sweets, and stays true to her methods when it comes to making them. This does cause her to butt heads with those who disagree with her quite often, however.

[From [url=https://stella.nekonyansoft.com/character.html]official website[/url]]
